processes:task-pv-improve-transform-4x8a.plain_language_name: Draw Up the Retire-or-Pivot Options for Each Failing Proposition
processes:task-pv-improve-transform-4x8a.plain_language_description: With the justification assessment checked, the option work proper begins. The processing custodian works each failing proposition into its candidate paths, producing the retire-or-pivot option set in the form the activity's definition specifies. The working papers are kept for the audit trail.
processes:task-pv-improve-transform-4x8a.business_purpose: It exists because a proposition that failed its justification needs concrete retirement and pivot paths on the table before any rationalization decision can be committed.
processes:task-pv-improve-transform-4x8a.practical_context: It opens when the checked justification material is ready to be worked, and it closes with the option set produced in the agreed form and the workings filed.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in product management takes the checked assessment for an underperforming proposition and drafts its two paths, retire with the offering withdrawn or pivot with a repositioned proposition, keeping the workings for the audit trail.

processes:task-pv-improve-verify-ke92bq.plain_language_name: Check the Justification Assessments Feeding the Option Set
processes:task-pv-improve-verify-ke92bq.plain_language_description: Before any retire-or-pivot option is drawn up, the incoming justification assessments are put to the test. The verification custodian tests the arriving material against what the activity requires. Shortfalls are written down, either for rejection or for putting right.
processes:task-pv-improve-verify-ke92bq.business_purpose: It exists because options drawn up on an unsound justification assessment would steer a failing proposition toward the wrong path.
processes:task-pv-improve-verify-ke92bq.practical_context: It opens once intake has registered the assessment material, and it closes with the material verified fit or its shortcomings written down for rejection or repair.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in product management receives the justification assessment for a proposition that missed its targets and confirms it carries the evidence the option work needs before anything is drawn up.

processes:task-pv-improve-record-bqarsg.plain_language_name: File the Outcome Measurement Audit Record
processes:task-pv-improve-record-bqarsg.plain_language_description: After confirmation, the measurement work is put beyond doubt for later scrutiny. The records custodian preserves the audit record at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles. The realized-outcome evidence therefore outlives the wave that produced it.

processes:task-pv-improve-record-bqarsg.practical_context: It opens once confirmation has been issued, and it closes with the measurement's audit record held at its required retention tier and its retrieval handles in place.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian in product management files the outcome measurement dossier for a completed rationalization wave at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so an auditor can pull the evidence years later.

processes:task-pv-improve-confirm-q9gp5d.plain_language_name: Confirm the Outcome Measurements and Hand Them On
processes:task-pv-improve-confirm-q9gp5d.plain_language_description: With the measuring done, the result is readied for whoever acts on it. The confirmation custodian tells the downstream teams the outcome measurement is available, and closes the reconciliation against what the activity promised.
processes:task-pv-improve-confirm-q9gp5d.business_purpose: It exists because a measurement that sits unannounced cannot inform the next round of rationalization decisions or close out the ones already taken.
processes:task-pv-improve-confirm-q9gp5d.practical_context: It opens when processing has finished the measurement, and it closes with confirmation issued, the downstream teams told it is ready, and the reconciliation closed.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian in product management announces to the portfolio review teams that the outcome measurement for the latest rationalization wave is ready, and reconciles what was produced against what the activity promised before standing the work down.

processes:task-pv-improve-intake-a8pqvf.plain_language_name: Log the Arriving Rationalization Measurement Materials
processes:task-pv-improve-intake-a8pqvf.plain_language_description: The measuring work opens when the material for scoring committed rationalization decisions arrives. The intake custodian logs them against the outcome measurement file so the measuring starts accounted for.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in product management receives the pre-decision portfolio baseline for a rationalization wave and logs it into the outcome measurement file, so the scoring of what the decisions delivered starts accounted for.

processes:task-pv-improve-transform-ne65.plain_language_description: Once the inputs are verified, the measuring itself is done. processes:task-pv-improve-transform-ne65.practical_context: It opens when the verified inputs are ready to be worked, and it closes with the outcome measurement produced in the agreed form and the workings retained.

processes:task-pv-improve-verify-8wg95c.plain_language_name: Check the Measurement Inputs Against the Baseline
processes:task-pv-improve-verify-8wg95c.plain_language_description: Before any scoring is done, the arriving measurement material is put to the test. processes:task-pv-improve-verify-8wg95c.business_purpose: It exists because an outcome measurement built on a defective baseline would misreport what the rationalization actually achieved.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian in product management files the audit record for the lifecycle updates at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so a reviewer can walk any proposition's stage history back to its sources.

processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-ux8xwc.plain_language_name: Confirm the Current Lifecycle Record to Its Users
processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-ux8xwc.plain_language_description: Once the record is current, the people who plan against it are told. The confirmation custodian tells the downstream teams the updated lifecycle record is available, and closes the reconciliation against what the activity promised.
processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-ux8xwc.business_purpose: It exists because stage planning and gate preparation both run off the lifecycle record, and its users must know when it has moved on.
processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-ux8xwc.practical_context: It opens when processing has finished the update, and it closes with confirmation issued, the record's users told it is ready, and the reconciliation closed.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian in product management tells the planning teams the lifecycle record now carries the latest stage histories and gate outcomes, and closes the reconciliation against what the maintenance work promised.

processes:task-pv-operate-intake-k9pkzp.plain_language_description: The record work opens as the material that moves a proposition's lifecycle arrives, chiefly transitions and gate decisions. The intake custodian logs them against the lifecycle record file so the maintaining starts accounted for.
processes:task-pv-operate-intake-k9pkzp.business_purpose: It exists because a stage history assembled from unlogged transitions and decisions is an account nobody can trust.
processes:task-pv-operate-intake-k9pkzp.practical_context: It opens when a transition or a gate decision is presented for the record with the activity's owner told that it has landed, and it closes with the intake registered.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in product management logs a completed transition and its gate outcome into the lifecycle record file, so the day's maintenance of the stage histories starts accounted for.

processes:task-pv-operate-transform-wh62.plain_language_name: Bring the Lifecycle Record Up to Date
processes:task-pv-operate-transform-wh62.plain_language_description: With the updates verified, the record itself is brought current. The processing custodian works the transitions and gate outcomes into each proposition's history, producing the current stage account in the form the activity's definition specifies. The working papers are kept for the audit trail.
processes:task-pv-operate-transform-wh62.business_purpose: It exists because planners and reviewers need every proposition's stage history and gate outcomes current, and this step makes them so.
processes:task-pv-operate-transform-wh62.practical_context: It opens when the verified updates are ready to be applied, and it closes with the lifecycle record current in the agreed form and the workings retained.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in product management applies the verified updates to the lifecycle record, extending a proposition's stage history with its new stage and gate outcome, and keeps the workings for the audit trail.

processes:task-pv-operate-verify-ee6yhm.plain_language_name: Check the Lifecycle Updates Before Entry
processes:task-pv-operate-verify-ee6yhm.plain_language_description: Before anything enters the lifecycle record, the arriving updates are put to the test. The verification custodian tests the arriving material against what the activity requires. Shortfalls are written down, either for rejection or for putting right.
processes:task-pv-operate-verify-ee6yhm.business_purpose: It exists because a stage history or gate outcome entered unchecked would corrupt the account every lifecycle decision leans on.
processes:task-pv-operate-verify-ee6yhm.practical_context: It opens once intake has registered the updates, and it closes with them verified fit for the record or their defects logged.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in product management checks an incoming gate outcome against the executed decision papers, notices the recorded stage does not match the decision, and writes the shortfall down for correction.

processes:task-pv-operate-record-3a5jmn.plain_language_name: File the Stage Transition Audit Record
processes:task-pv-operate-record-3a5jmn.plain_language_description: After confirmation, the transition round is put beyond doubt for later scrutiny. The records custodian preserves the audit record at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles. Each stage move and its grounds therefore stay answerable.
processes:task-pv-operate-record-3a5jmn.business_purpose: It exists because a stage change decides what a proposition owes next, and the grounds behind each move must stay retrievable.
processes:task-pv-operate-record-3a5jmn.practical_context: It opens once confirmation has been issued, and it closes with the transition audit record held at its required retention tier and its retrieval handles in place.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian in product management files the audit record for the executed transitions at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so the grounds behind any stage move can be retrieved on demand.

processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-5uc6r8.plain_language_name: Confirm the Stage Moves to the Proposition Teams
processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-5uc6r8.plain_language_description: Once the moves are made, the teams whose propositions have shifted are told. The confirmation custodian tells the downstream teams the executed transitions are available, and closes the reconciliation against what the activity promised.
processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-5uc6r8.business_purpose: It exists because a team's obligations change with its proposition's stage, and the team must hear officially when the move has happened.
processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-5uc6r8.practical_context: It opens when processing has executed the transitions, and it closes with confirmation issued, the downstream teams told, and the reconciliation closed.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian in product management tells the proposition teams their stage moves are executed and official, and closes the reconciliation against what the transition work promised for the round.

processes:task-pv-operate-intake-xsgcyz.plain_language_name: Take In the Transition Request Papers
processes:task-pv-operate-intake-xsgcyz.plain_language_description: The transition work opens as the cases for moving propositions between stages arrive. The intake custodian logs them against the transition file so the managing starts accounted for.
processes:task-pv-operate-intake-xsgcyz.business_purpose: It exists because a stage move made without a logged case cannot be checked against the stage criteria or defended afterwards.
processes:task-pv-operate-intake-xsgcyz.practical_context: It opens when a transition case is presented for handling with the activity's owner told that it has landed, and it closes with the intake registered.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in product management logs a proposition's case for moving from introduction into growth into the transition file, so the handling of the move starts accounted for.

processes:task-pv-operate-transform-yvsf.plain_language_description: With the cases verified, the moves themselves are made. The processing custodian works each proposition from its stage to the next, producing the executed transitions in the form the activity's definition specifies. The working papers are kept for the audit trail.
processes:task-pv-operate-transform-yvsf.business_purpose: It exists because the lifecycle only means anything while propositions actually move between stages when their criteria are met.
processes:task-pv-operate-transform-yvsf.practical_context: It opens when the verified cases are ready to be executed, and it closes with the transitions carried out in the agreed form and the workings retained.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in product management executes the verified transition, formally moving the proposition from introduction into growth and recording the move, with the workings kept for the audit trail.

processes:task-pv-operate-verify-gvmbtj.plain_language_name: Check Each Transition Case Against the Stage Criteria
processes:task-pv-operate-verify-gvmbtj.plain_language_description: Before a proposition is moved, its case is put to the test. The verification custodian tests the arriving material against what the activity requires. Shortfalls are written down, either for rejection or for putting right.
processes:task-pv-operate-verify-gvmbtj.business_purpose: It exists because moving a proposition between stages on an unproven case places it in a stage its performance does not support.
processes:task-pv-operate-verify-gvmbtj.practical_context: It opens once intake has registered the transition cases, and it closes with them verified against the stage criteria or their defects logged.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in product management tests a growth-stage case against the stage criteria and the proposition's tracked position, finds the growth evidence thin, and writes the shortfall down for rejection or repair.

processes:task-pv-operate-record-6vjdr4.plain_language_name: File the Stage Tracking Audit Record
processes:task-pv-operate-record-6vjdr4.plain_language_description: After confirmation, the tracking round is put beyond doubt for later scrutiny. The records custodian preserves the audit record at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles. The evidence behind each stage reading therefore stays retrievable.
processes:task-pv-operate-record-6vjdr4.business_purpose: It exists because stage readings that are later challenged at a gate or a review need their supporting evidence on hand.
processes:task-pv-operate-record-6vjdr4.practical_context: It opens once confirmation has been issued, and it closes with the tracking audit record held at its required retention tier and its retrieval handles in place.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian in product management files the audit record behind the stage readings at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so a gate review can pull the evidence that placed a proposition in maturity.

processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-skckdn.plain_language_name: Hand the Stage Tracking Record On
processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-skckdn.plain_language_description: Once the positions are set down, the teams who plan by them are told. The confirmation custodian tells the downstream teams the stage tracking record is available, and closes the reconciliation against what the activity promised.
processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-skckdn.business_purpose: It exists because transition cases and gate preparation both start from the tracked positions, so their users must know when the record has moved.
processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-skckdn.practical_context: It opens when processing has finished the tracking, and it closes with confirmation issued, the downstream teams told it is ready, and the reconciliation closed.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian in product management tells the lifecycle planning teams the refreshed stage tracking record is ready, and closes the reconciliation against what the tracking work promised before the round closes.

processes:task-pv-operate-intake-yjr7je.plain_language_description: The tracking opens as the signals bearing on each proposition's stage arrive. The intake custodian logs them against the stage tracking file so the tracking starts accounted for.
processes:task-pv-operate-intake-yjr7je.business_purpose: It exists because knowing where each proposition sits between introduction and decline starts with an accounted set of arriving signals.
processes:task-pv-operate-intake-yjr7je.practical_context: It opens when a round of signals is presented for stage tracking with the activity's owner told that it has landed, and it closes with the intake registered.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in product management logs the week's signals into the stage tracking file, so the work of keeping every proposition's stage position current starts accounted for.

processes:task-pv-operate-transform-prcf.plain_language_name: Update the Stage Positions of the Propositions
processes:task-pv-operate-transform-prcf.plain_language_description: With the signals verified, the positions themselves are read and set down. The processing custodian reads each proposition against introduction, growth, maturity, and decline, producing the stage tracking record in the form the activity's definition specifies. The working papers are kept for the audit trail.
processes:task-pv-operate-transform-prcf.business_purpose: It exists because every lifecycle decision starts from where a proposition actually sits, and this step keeps that answer current.
processes:task-pv-operate-transform-prcf.practical_context: It opens when the verified signals are ready to be read, and it closes with the stage tracking record produced in the agreed form and the workings retained.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in product management reads the verified signals and updates the stage tracking record, holding one proposition in growth and moving another into maturity, with the workings kept for the audit trail.

processes:task-pv-operate-verify-fcvpe3.plain_language_name: Check the Signals That Bear on Stage Positions
processes:task-pv-operate-verify-fcvpe3.plain_language_description: Before a stage position is read from them, the signals are put to the test. The verification custodian tests the arriving material against what the activity requires. Shortfalls are written down, either for rejection or for putting right.
processes:task-pv-operate-verify-fcvpe3.business_purpose: It exists because a proposition tracked in the wrong stage misdirects every decision that stage implies.
processes:task-pv-operate-verify-fcvpe3.practical_context: It opens once intake has registered the signals, and it closes with them verified fit for the tracking or their defects logged.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in product management checks the signals behind a maturity reading, notices a sales feed double-counting one region, and writes the shortfall down for the feed to be put right.

processes:task-pv-operate-record-v9qpy9.plain_language_name: File the Catalogue Pricing Audit Record
processes:task-pv-operate-record-v9qpy9.plain_language_description: After confirmation, the pricing round is put beyond doubt for later scrutiny. The records custodian preserves the audit record at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles. Every price shown to buyers can then be traced to its authority.
processes:task-pv-operate-record-v9qpy9.business_purpose: It exists because prices carry commercial and regulatory weight, and the authority behind each one must stay retrievable.
processes:task-pv-operate-record-v9qpy9.practical_context: It opens once confirmation has been issued, and it closes with the pricing audit record held at its required retention tier and its retrieval handles in place.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian in product management files the audit record for the administered pricing at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so any price on the catalogue can later be traced to its launch pricing or rule authority.

processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-mha68v.plain_language_name: Confirm the Catalogue Pricing to the Sales Channels
processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-mha68v.plain_language_description: Once the prices are administered, the teams who sell on them are told. The confirmation custodian tells the downstream teams the administered catalogue pricing is available, and closes the reconciliation against what the activity promised.
processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-mha68v.business_purpose: It exists because channels quoting from stale prices oversell or undersell, so they must hear when the catalogue pricing has moved.
processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-mha68v.practical_context: It opens when processing has finished the pricing work, and it closes with confirmation issued, the downstream teams told it is ready, and the reconciliation closed.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian in product management tells the channel and sales teams the new catalogue pricing is in force and ready, and closes the reconciliation against what the pricing work promised.

processes:task-pv-operate-intake-qmfamc.plain_language_name: Book In the Arriving Pricing Papers
processes:task-pv-operate-intake-qmfamc.plain_language_description: The pricing work opens as the material that sets or moves catalogue prices arrives, chiefly launch pricing and rule updates. The intake custodian logs them against the pricing file so the administering starts accounted for.
processes:task-pv-operate-intake-qmfamc.business_purpose: It exists because the prices buyers see must be traceable to logged and authorised inputs from the very first step.
processes:task-pv-operate-intake-qmfamc.practical_context: It opens when pricing material is presented for administration with the activity's owner told that it has landed, and it closes with the intake registered.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in product management logs a new product's launch pricing and a seasonal rule change into the pricing file, so the administering of catalogue prices starts accounted for.

processes:task-pv-operate-transform-ehw8.plain_language_name: Apply the Administered Prices to the Catalogue
processes:task-pv-operate-transform-ehw8.plain_language_description: With the papers verified, the prices themselves are administered. The processing custodian works the launch pricing and rule outcomes into the catalogue figures, producing the administered catalogue pricing in the form the activity's definition specifies. The working papers are kept for the audit trail.
processes:task-pv-operate-transform-ehw8.business_purpose: It exists because the catalogue is where buyers meet prices, so the administered figures must actually take effect there.
processes:task-pv-operate-transform-ehw8.practical_context: It opens when the verified pricing is ready to be applied, and it closes with the catalogue pricing administered in the agreed form and the workings retained.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in product management applies the verified launch pricing to the catalogue entries and works the seasonal rule through the affected prices, keeping the workings for the audit trail.

processes:task-pv-operate-verify-su5ehj.plain_language_name: Check the Pricing Papers Against the Pricing Rules
processes:task-pv-operate-verify-su5ehj.plain_language_description: Before a price reaches the catalogue, its papers are put to the test. The verification custodian tests the arriving material against what the activity requires. Shortfalls are written down, either for rejection or for putting right.
processes:task-pv-operate-verify-su5ehj.business_purpose: It exists because a price administered outside the set rules would show buyers figures the business never authorised.
processes:task-pv-operate-verify-su5ehj.practical_context: It opens once intake has registered the pricing papers, and it closes with them verified against the pricing requirements or their defects logged.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in product management checks a proposed price move against the set pricing rules, finds the margin floor breached, and writes the shortfall down for the pricing owner to put right.

processes:task-pv-operate-record-aj6tf3.plain_language_name: File the Catalogue Entry Audit Trail
processes:task-pv-operate-record-aj6tf3.plain_language_description: After confirmation, the maintenance round is put beyond doubt for later scrutiny. The records custodian preserves the audit record at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles. Each entry change can then be traced to the baseline and state behind it.
processes:task-pv-operate-record-aj6tf3.business_purpose: It exists because what the catalogue said about a product at any moment must stay reconstructible from its trail.
processes:task-pv-operate-record-aj6tf3.practical_context: It opens once confirmation has been issued, and it closes with the entry audit record held at its required retention tier and its retrieval handles in place.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian in product management files the audit record for the catalogue entry changes at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles, so a dispute over what a listing once said can be settled from the trail.

processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-xfpdy3.plain_language_name: Confirm the Current Entries to the Channels
processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-xfpdy3.plain_language_description: Once the entries are current, the teams who trade on them are told. processes:task-pv-operate-confirm-xfpdy3.practical_context: It opens when processing has finished the entry work, and it closes with confirmation issued, the downstream teams told it is ready, and the reconciliation closed.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian in product management tells the channel teams the updated catalogue entries are live and ready, and closes the reconciliation against what the entry maintenance promised for the round.

processes:task-pv-operate-transform-6tyk.plain_language_name: Bring the Catalogue Entries Up to Date

processes:task-pv-operate-verify-qp59st.plain_language_description: Before an entry is changed, the arriving material is put to the test. processes:task-pv-operate-verify-qp59st.practical_context: It opens once intake has registered the change papers, and it closes with them verified fit for the entries or their defects logged.

processes:task-pv-operate-record-qr65se.plain_language_description: After confirmation, the integrity round is put beyond doubt for later scrutiny.
